# ExamSeat Pro

> AI-powered examination seating and invigilation management system for engineering colleges, built with Firebase and Gemini AI.

ExamSeat Pro helps institutions generate fair seating plans (preventing adjacent same-branch students), manage invigilation duties, and let students instantly locate their exam seats.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview and entry to Admin, HOD, Faculty, and Student panels.
- [Student Seat Lookup](/student/verify): Students verify identity to find their assigned seat.
- [Faculty Verification](/faculty/verify): Faculty verify identity to view invigilation duties.
